title: Palantir Stock News (Oct 14, 2026): PLTR Falls 0.2% to $208.67
summary: Palantir (PLTR) closed at $208.67 on Oct 13, down 0.16%, as investors weighed a revised Baird view and the stock tracked a softer Nasdaq.
body_markdown:
## Why Palantir Stock Fell


No fetched source names a new company-specific event behind the small decline. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/palantir-stocks-fall-baird-lifts-204811761.html) , PLTR traded lower during the October 13 session as investors weighed Baird's more bullish outlook, after the firm revised its view on the stock on October 12, citing Investor's Business Daily. GuruFocus added that a higher analyst view "adds nothing to the company's revenue until customers actually spend."


The backdrop is a sharp run. Per[Barchart](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/60-rally-just-3-months-165325292.html) , the shares have climbed about 60% over the past three months, following stronger than expected second quarter results and a raised outlook. The 0.16% dip matched the Nasdaq's move, with no fresh company news reported.


According to[Palantir's Q2 2026 earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001321655/000132165526000039/a2026q2ex991pressrelease.htm) filed with the SEC on August 3, 2026, revenue grew 93% year over year to $1.935 billion and US commercial revenue rose 149% to $764 million. The company guided third quarter revenue to $2.160 billion to $2.164 billion and raised full year 2026 revenue guidance to $8.150 billion to $8.158 billion, implying 82% growth.


## PLTR Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Palantir raised its full year 2026 revenue guidance to 82% growth and its US commercial revenue guidance to at least 134% growth, according to the company's Q2 release.
- Barchart reported that remaining deal value reached $13.1 billion, up 83% year over year, and US commercial customers rose 35% to 653.
- As reported by[Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/crowdstrike-vs-palantir-technologies-revenue-235549445.html) , Palantir secured a prime contracting agreement with the US Army Contracting Command and partnered with Nvidia on its commercial AI software.


### Risks


- GuruFocus noted stock-based compensation of $265.2 million, about 13.7% of Q2 revenue, which creates dilution risk.
- After a 60% three-month rise, GuruFocus wrote that "the next results must supply the proof," putting the third quarter report under close watch.
- Barchart reported that revenue from the 20 largest customers averaged about $124 million each, showing how much the business leans on a small group of large accounts.
